title: Kasami Sequence Generator
text: Generate Kasami sequence from set of Kasami sequences, 3 inputs, 1 output, {Sequence index(es)} sets Sequence index; {Generator polynomial}, {Initial states}, {Shift} sets the sequence offset from starting point, {Output variable-size signals} sets the option to output variable-length signals, {Maximum output size source}, {Maximum output size}, {Sample time} sets the output sample time, {Samples per frame}, {Reset on nonzero input} sets the option to reset output signal and {Output data type}. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: Ref
ports.summary: Reference input signal scalar | column vector

params.name: Generator polynomial
params.values: Generator polynomial ’z^6 + z + 1’ (default) | polynomial character vector | string scalar | binary-valued row vector | integer-valued row vector

params.name: Initial states
params.values: Initial states [0 0 0 0 0 1] (default) | binary-valued scalar | binary-valued row vector

params.name: Sequence index(es)
params.values: Sequence index 0 (default) | integer | vector of the form [ k m ]

params.name: Shift
params.values: Sequence offset from starting point 0 (default) | integer

params.name: Output variable-size signals
params.values: Option to output variable-length signals off (default) | on

params.name: Maximum output size source
params.values: Maximum output size source Dialog parameter (default) | Inherit from reference port

params.name: Maximum output size
params.values: Maximum output size [10 1] (default) | vector of the form [ n 1]

params.name: Reset on nonzero input
params.values: Option to reset output signal off (default) | on
